title: smime-tree: no ECDH (P-256/P-384) encrypt/decrypt test coverage
description: smime_tests.rs only has RSA fixture-based tests. There are no round-trip tests for P-256 or P-384 ECDH encrypt/decrypt. The KARI path in decrypt.rs (try_decrypt_kari, map_kari_alg, ecdh_wrap_cek) and build_p256_recipient/build_p384_recipient in encrypt.rs have zero test coverage. Scenario: a future contributor changes ecdh_wrap_cek SharedInfo construction or the KDF order and the bug is invisible because no test catches it. Minimum acceptable: one P-256 round-trip test using an OpenSSL-generated fixture or a Python pyca/cryptography-generated fixture as oracle.
